recommendation: Keep the FHIR-24666 audit commit as-is. Handle MedicationStatement.basedOn only through FHIR-55888 or another explicit Pharmacy work item/run that includes Resolved - change required issues.
issue_request: FHIR-24666 asked to link MedicationStatement, MedicationDispense, and MedicationAdministration to CarePlan like MedicationRequest.basedOn. The final Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution narrowed the applied change to adding basedOn to MedicationDispense and MedicationAdministration with cardinality 0..* and Reference(CarePlan).
initial_application: Jira records the issue as committed on 2019-09-20 in HL7/fhir commit 2933d19faad5a9c3da59470ac68ba7222b4495d7. That commit added MedicationAdministration.basedOn and MedicationDispense.basedOn spreadsheet rows with 0..* Reference(CarePlan), and the R5 source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried those rows into the current StructureDefinition XML source.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, and MedicationStatement are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current MedicationStatement has no basedOn element and instead uses derivedFrom guidance for links to underlying requests, dispenses, administrations, and other evidence. Later FHIR-27019 corrected MedicationAdministration.basedOn wording, and later FHIR-55888 is a separate Resolved - change required R6 decision to restore MedicationStatement.basedOn.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the two CarePlan basedOn elements required by FHIR-24666 are already present, and adding MedicationStatement.basedOn here would over-apply the seed and duplicate the later FHIR-55888 decision path.
